newsitem.title: USA: Lukens Medical says will acquire Techsynt.
newsitem.headline: Lukens Medical says will acquire Techsynt.

text.p: Lukens Medical Corp said Thursday it signed an agreement to acquire a majority interest in Techsynt S.A., a privately-owned suture manufacturer based in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Luken said its investment will be primarily in the form of equipment and inventory. A spokesman said the purchase price was "less than a million dollars" but declined to comment further.

The company said Techsynt will expand its manufacturing capabilities to include specialty sutures and Lukens new synthetic, absorbable PGA suture, and will market under the brand name Techsynt-Lukens.
